Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Terminal 1.0.102

1. Fixed: after "Restart to update" the app no longer shows a crash notice at the next start.
2. The TradeNextFX logo mark and app icon are the brand's own artwork, and the name at the top left, on the sign-in window and in the status line shows in the brand's own two colours.
3. Each broker's app keeps its own saved sign-ins and settings, so apps from different brokers on one PC never share them. Settings has an Uninstall option that also removes this app's saved data (ticked by default).
4. Chart: zoom in much further, so a few candles can fill the chart; candles are solid with crisp edges and wicks in both themes.
5. Chart: at the live right edge the chart follows new candles as they form; scrolled back into history it stays where you left it.
6. Chart: the Indicators, Drawing tools, Layout and right-click menus share one clean style in both themes.
7. Chart settings: a new layout with sections on the left (Symbol, Status line, Scales and lines, Canvas, Trading sessions), colour swatches with a palette, a Template button and Cancel / Save.
8. Drawing tools: every tool is drawn crisp and smooth at any angle and size; hovering a drawing shows its handles and makes it slightly bolder, with no halo.
9. Positions on the chart: each tag sits at its own price; the dotted line keeps the same clearly visible dots at any zoom; lines and tags are easier to click; where several positions overlap a click lists them so you pick the one you want; the close cross turns red under the pointer; a selected position's line and tag are highlighted.

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
# Terminal 1.0.103

Order ticket

1. On a limit or stop order the price now starts at the current market once and is an ordinary box you edit: it no longer follows the market, and the re-sync arrow is gone.
2. The ticket shows a line of text only when something is actually wrong (an invalid price, stop loss or take profit, or not enough margin), and then just one short line.

Updates and live data

3. When TradeNextFX marks a version as no longer supported, the app updates itself before you can trade, with a progress bar; your open positions stay on the server. If the update server cannot be reached the screen says so and offers Retry.
4. A symbol, group or account setting changed by TradeNextFX shows in the terminal within a second, and the terminal reads them again after any reconnect.

Stop loss and take profit

5. Stop loss and take profit can be set as an amount in your account currency, beside the price: under the Stop loss and Take profit boxes of the order ticket, in Modify, in Modify all and when you edit a pending order, pick Price, Pips or Amount. The position closes when its floating profit or loss reaches the amount. Pips and price work as before. The Amount choice appears only once TradeNextFX supports it on your account; the Trade tab shows an amount as money (stop loss red, take profit blue), and a refusal shows the reason in the window where you clicked.

Chart and tables

6. The ticker along the top always scrolls. When your Market Watch has only a few symbols, the strip is filled out with the broker's default symbols (yours stay first), so it never stands still.
7. The execution strip under a trade in History is gone, with its "Execution" line in the menu. The LOG still ends each order, change and close with how long it took.
8. The status bar shows your connection speed, for example "Ping 42 ms".
9. Right-click in History now opens a full menu: View, Period, Report, Columns and Show on chart. Choose Show on chart on a trade to see its entry and exit as arrows on the chart, from the trade's own times and prices. Choosing another trade replaces them, and "Clear chart marks" removes them.
10. The SELL / BUY strip on the chart has no box behind it any more, in light or dark; the 1-CLICK chip stays on the left.
11. The STATEMENT button in History now looks like the 1-CLICK chip: no fill and a thin line.
12. On the sign-in card, "UPDATE AVAILABLE" has its own line under the logo instead of sitting beside it.
13. Settings: section headings use the brand colour and all labels are in the interface font; only values are in the figures font.
